package.description: Mafold from your terminal — a CLI client and a coding-agent daemon.

en-US.description: Mafold from your terminal — a CLI client and a coding-agent daemon.
en-US.longDescription:
Mafold from your terminal. Two things in one binary:

A CLI client for your Mafold account — list conversations, send messages,
manage bots, wallet, cards and mini-apps from the shell.

An agent daemon: `mafold agent` runs a local coding agent (Claude Code,
Codex, and others) as your Mafold bot, so a chat message drives real work
in a real working directory on your own machine, and the transcript comes
back to the conversation as it happens. The credentials and the code never
leave your computer.
en-US.name: Mafold CLI
